title: Minneapolis Housing & Code Violations
description: Housing and property code violations cited by Minneapolis Regulatory Services: address, parcel, case type, violation code and description, status, processed and resolved dates. Filter by date, address, case type or open status.
why: A code violation is a property with a problem and a deadline. Investors read it as a distress signal; contractors read it as a job that has to be done.
useCases: Contractors (roofing, windows, exterior, snow) finding owners under a repair order

processedSince.title: Processed on or after (YYYY-MM-DD)
processedSince.description: Only violations processed on or after this date.
